intro.text: The koloss-blooded leader of the Nightstreet Gang, whom Constable Matieu of Ironstand calls "little and feisty".

items.text: Donny headed the Nightstreet Gang by 342 PC, but either sat out its attack on Wax's train to New Seran or got away without running into Wax. Afterwards Constable Matieu planned to take a posse after him and the rest of the gang.
